description: Grade a building A to F by BBL, per apartment, from city records. Returns the grade, number of apartments, open hazardous (Class C) violations and violations per apartment, evictions and evictions per 100 apartments per year since 2017, rent-impairing violations, oldest open violation date and last eviction. The grade is computed by fixed rules; always report it exactly as returned.

configuration.query:
FROM hpd_violations, evictions METADATA _index
| WHERE bbl == ?bbl
| EVAL is_v = CASE(_index == "hpd_violations", 1, 0), is_e = CASE(_index == "evictions", 1, 0), ri = CASE(rentimpairing == "Y", 1, 0), lat = ST_Y(location), lon = ST_X(location)
| STATS open_hazardous_violations = SUM(is_v), evictions = SUM(is_e), rent_impairing_violations = SUM(ri), oldest_open_violation = MIN(inspectiondate), last_eviction = MAX(executed_date), apartments = MAX(units), lat = MAX(lat), lon = MAX(lon)
| EVAL years_of_eviction_records = DATE_DIFF("day", TO_DATETIME("2017-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"), NOW()) / 365.25
| EVAL violations_per_apartment = ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(open_hazardous_violations) / apartments, 2), evictions_per_100_apartments_per_year = ROUND(TO_DOUBLE(evictions) * 100.0 / apartments / years_of_eviction_records, 2), days_oldest_open = DATE_DIFF("day", oldest_open_violation, NOW())
| EVAL grade = CASE(open_hazardous_violations IS NULL OR (open_hazardous_violations == 0 AND evictions == 0), "A", apartments IS NULL, "not graded: apartment count unknown", violations_per_apartment >= 1.0 OR evictions_per_100_apartments_per_year >= 3.0, "F", violations_per_apartment >= 0.5 OR evictions_per_100_apartments_per_year >= 2.0, "D", violations_per_apartment >= 0.2 OR evictions_per_100_apartments_per_year >= 1.0 OR days_oldest_open > 730, "C", "B")
| EVAL point = CONCAT("POINT(", TO_STRING(lon), " ", TO_STRING(lat), ")"), grade_rank = CASE(grade == "A", 0, grade == "B", 1, grade == "C", 2, grade == "D", 3, grade == "F", 4, 9)
| KEEP grade, grade_rank, point, apartments, open_hazardous_violations, violations_per_apartment, evictions, evictions_per_100_apartments_per_year, rent_impairing_violations, oldest_open_violation, days_oldest_open, last_eviction
